current.text: He started the preseason opener and is in the Warriors' expected starting lineup with Podziemski and Gui Santos, with Draymond Green at center.
Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody are out at the start of the season. Butler is out for at least half the season.
Experts expect his role and numbers to drop when Butler and Moody return, and expect Warriors players in general to fade as the season goes on.
The Porzingis news gives him a usage boost. His minutes go up the more Draymond Green plays center.
Experts now take him around picks 98 to 106 in 9-cat mocks and say to move him up because he will start. Josh says he has real redraft value with the Warriors this season.
Experts expect rookie struggles and a drop in shooting from his Summer League, where a 48% three-point rate boosted his numbers.
Steve Kerr rarely starts rookies, has little patience with them and often changes his starting lineup a few games in, so the starting job is not secure.
The Warriors' schedule is good for fantasy playoffs ending March 28. The team has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most.

durable.text: He is a low-usage player who fits in around others, not a creator of his own shot.
He is a versatile forward who adds rebounds, assists, steals and blocks, can grab a rebound and push the ball himself, and passes well.
Threes are his weakest category for a forward.
One expert calls him a poor free throw shooter. Site projections put him near 80% on low volume.
Experts disagree on his defense. Some call him good defensively, others expect defensive problems in the NBA.
He has no clear NBA position.

note: He is a late, cheap target. Yahoo's average cost is 1.4 USD and ESPN's is 1.3 USD, his ranks are 124 and 175, and experts now take him around picks 98 to 106 as a starter. He gives a little of everything (BLK +0.7 vs forwards) and is a natural punt 3PM fit, but the sites split hard on threes (Yahoo 1.3, ESPN 0.3 per game). Early on, check that he keeps the starting job under Kerr and what his minutes are. Plan to sell or replace him before Butler and Moody return.
